concerns.text: FR-001 (controlled topology) and SC-001 (correlation measurement) require 'Stratified Orthogonalization' logic to decouple depth and branching factors. Task T013 is marked [ ] (incomplete) and explicitly states 'Implement Stratified Orthogonalization logic'. Without this task, the dataset will have confounding variables, making the research question untestable.

FR-007 (randomized path perturbation) and SC-006 (divergence measurement) require a mechanism to select a ground-truth path different from the longest path. Task T015 is marked [ ] (incomplete). The spec explicitly states this prevents tautological validation; without it, the validation logic is flawed.

FR-002 (RM inference loop) and SC-003 (CPU-feasibility) require the core execution loop implementation. Task T022 is marked [ ] (incomplete). The entire US2 (CPU-Feasible Baseline Execution) depends on this task to generate the `execution_log.csv` required for US3.

FR-008 (extended budget validation) and SC-007 (budget exhaustion rate) require an extended run with a 1000-turn limit. Task T028 is marked [ ] (incomplete). Without this, the system cannot distinguish between 'reasoning failure' and 'budget exhaustion', violating the core research design.

FR-004 (Spearman correlation) and SC-001 require statistical analysis. Task T033 is marked [ ] (incomplete). The plan explicitly requires Cox PH and Segmented Regression; T033 is the only task addressing the primary statistical analysis (Cox PH/Spearman).

FR-005 (Sensitivity Analysis) and SC-002 (tipping point) require Segmented Regression to identify the 'tipping point'. Task T034 is marked [ ] (incomplete). Without this, the system cannot identify the non-linear degradation pattern described in the spec.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) requires a pinned environment and directory structure. Tasks T001 (Create directories) and T002 (Create __init__.py) are marked [ ] (incomplete). While T003 pins versions, the physical structure and package initialization are missing, preventing a reproducible run.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and Plan.md 'Technical Context' require linting/formatting and environment variable configuration. Tasks T004 (Configure linting) and T008 (Configure env vars) are marked [ ] (incomplete). Missing these prevents consistent code quality and seed management.
